headline: Approved liquor license application for Burlington Asian Market Vermont LLC at 1 Intervale Avenue, and 2026-2027 liquor license renewals.
summary: The board approved a second class liquor license application for Burlington Asian Market Vermont LLC at 1 Intervale Avenue. It also approved first and third class liquor license renewals for 2026-2027 as part of the consent agenda. Both motions passed unanimously.
decisions: Approved the 2026-2027 First and Third Class Liquor License Renewals as listed, with all standard conditions, on the consent agenda; motion passed unanimously.
Approved the 2026-2027 Second Class Liquor License Application for Burlington Asian Market Vermont LLC, 1 Intervale Avenue, with all standard conditions; motion passed unanimously.
